jobs.description:
Role Overview

The CSM, Enterprise | Lifecycle will own the post-implementation experience for a book of enterprise customers, partnering with Account Management on long-term account strategy. They will drive sustained adoption, act as each customer's expert in finance workflows, and build multi-threaded relationships across every account.

What You Will Do

The CSM will own the post-implementation experience, drive sustained adoption, act as each customer's expert in finance workflows, and build multi-threaded relationships across every account.

Why It Might Be a Fit

The ideal candidate will have a customer experience mindset, executive relationship building skills, financial impact communication skills, AI fluency, data-driven book management skills, technical and systems acumen, and a builder mindset.

Requirements

  • Long-term account ownership
  • Customer experience mindset
  • Executive relationship building
  • Financial impact communication
  • AI fluency
  • Data-driven book management
  • Technical and systems acumen
  • Builder mindset

Benefits

  • Flexible PTO
  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering
  • Health and wellness stipend
  • Budget for intra-office travel
  • Weekly coffee stipend
  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
  • One Medical annual membership
  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
  • Pet insurance
  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
jobs.location_raw: New York, NY (HQ); San Francisco, CA

company_data.description_summary: Ramp offers an integrated financial operations platform that consolidates corporate cards, expense and spend management, bill payments, accounting automation, procurement, travel, and treasury functions into a single solution. By streamlining these processes, the platform helps businesses save time and money. 45,000 companies have collectively saved $10 billion and 27.5 million hours since 2019. Ramp's differentiation lies in its deep industry expertise, with a leadership team drawn from leading financial institutions and tech giants, and its proven track record of recognition on Fast Company, Forbes, and CNBC lists. The company's focus on empowering finance teams to work more efficiently positions it as a compelling choice for professionals seeking innovative fintech solutions.
